description:
Frondy is an Israeli electronic-signature service. With the Frondy app, ChatGPT works in the user's own Frondy account: add a contract attached in the chat or from a link, place signature and date fields, send it for signature by email, SMS, WhatsApp or link, see who has signed and who is still pending, remind signers, save and reuse templates, keep contacts and organise documents into folders, in English or Hebrew.

Every signature request is shown to the user as a summary first and goes out only after they confirm. The app uses the account's own permissions and plan limits. It cannot delete documents, folders, templates or contacts, make purchases or change billing or admin settings, and it never reads national ID numbers or passwords. Users sign in on Frondy's own page and can disconnect at any time in Frondy under Settings > External connections. Connecting requires a paid Frondy plan.

defaultPrompt: Which of my documents are still waiting for a signature?
Add this contract to Frondy and send it to my client for signature.
Remind everyone who hasn't signed yet.
